item.title: CVSS Version Support
item.description: DefectDojo supports CVSS metadata on Findings, including the CVSS 4.0 standard. This page describes which CVSS versions are stored end-to-end, where you can enter or view them, and what to expect from parser-side coverage.

item.title: EPSS / KEV
item.description: DefectDojo Pro automatically enriches your Findings with two external threat-intelligence sources — EPSS and CISA KEV — so that prioritization reflects how likely a vulnerability is to be exploited, not just its CVSS severity. Both sources match to Findings by CVE, refresh on a daily schedule, and feed directly into each Finding’s computed priority score.

item.title: Reachability
item.description: A Critical CVE in code your application never calls is not the same risk as the same CVE on a live request path. Reachability captures that difference: DefectDojo Pro records whether each Finding’s vulnerable code can actually be reached, shows you where that conclusion came from, and feeds it into the Finding’s computed priority.
